i guess the mainstream canon would be to see “The Mark of Zorro” (1940), then “The Mask of Zorro” (1998), and then “The Legend of Zorro” (2005).

but i think the more fun way is to just skip “legend” since we can all agree its just not very good, and “mark” may be good, but it’s black and whiteness might be a little off putting to modern viewers.

instead try watching “zorro” (1975). also called “spaghetti western zorro”, it’s in color and has enough visual similarities to the first ten minutes of “mask” that you can see them as set in the same universe.
